item.title: Katie Austin
item.description: We are very sad to announce that our much-loved long-term announcer Katie Austin passed away Thursday 5 September 2024. Katie had a huge following with her country music program on Tuesday afternoons. She was also very involved with the regular country music concerts in the Ilford Hall. She will be greatly missed.
